classification_policy.PRODUCTIVE: Reachable from the canonical product root through static internal imports.
classification_policy.SUPPORT_NECESSARY: Required engineering measurement, catalog, ingestion, delivery, or domain support outside the direct root closure.
classification_policy.EXPERIMENTAL_FROZEN: Not authorized for extension or productive invocation until explicitly absorbed.
classification_policy.OBSOLETE_ELIMINABLE: Superseded or contradictory candidate; may be deleted only after caller and regression audit.

safety_rules: Every Service 1 module must appear exactly once.
New modules fail registry validation until classified.
Only PRODUCTIVE modules may form the canonical execution path.
EXPERIMENTAL_FROZEN and OBSOLETE_ELIMINABLE modules must not be imported by the canonical root closure.
Deletion requires zero productive callers and passing focal plus neighboring regression tests.
